_comment: Single source of the Chromium launch flags shared by the Python (util/testing/frontend_visual.py, Playwright) and JS (frontend_visual/launcher.mjs, Puppeteer) browser launchers. containerBase makes headless Chromium run in containerized/RBE environments. deterministicExtra is measured, not assumed: every entry was confirmed to change renders by dropping it and comparing BuildBuddy artifact digests across the visual fleet. Add one only with the same evidence -- seventeen flags accumulated here that changed nothing at all.
